'''Forward Outpost Alpha''', originally known as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] '''Kanner Outpost''', was a military station built on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It served as a secure base for military and research personnel during the reconstruction of Taris. It was located in the southern reaches of the [[Sinking City]], and was captured and renamed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[invasion of Taris]].

==Personnel==
Sergeant Mack of the [[Republic Army]] and Representative Lessah were both stationed at Kanner Outpost along with Republic riflemen and other soldiers. At the time of the visit of a [[Star Wars: The Old Republic|traveling individual]] [[Matthew Herral]] and [[Evans Ketara]] are in an argument with Sergeant Mack.<ref name="TOR" />
